nrpe_port.description: Port on which the NRPE daemon listens for incoming connections.

items.description: Allowed IP address or hostname (CIDR not supported by standard NRPE). Use `127.0.0.1` for local-only, or `all` to disable access control (not recommended).

allowed_hosts.description: List of hosts permitted to connect to this NRPE daemon.

nrpe_user.description: System user account under which the NRPE daemon process runs.

nrpe_group.description: System group for the NRPE daemon process.

nrpe_logfile.description: Path to the NRPE daemon log file.

nrpe_log_level.description: Verbosity of logging: 0 (none) to 4 (debug). Higher levels increase log size.

command_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) allowed for any check command to complete before being terminated.

connection_timeout.description: Maximum time (seconds) allowed for a client to remain connected before the server closes the connection.

nrpe_ssl.description: Whether to use SSL/TLS encryption for communication between Nagios and NRPE.

nrpe_ssl_cert_file.description: Path to the SSL certificate file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

nrpe_ssl_key_file.description: Path to the SSL private key file (PEM format). Required if SSL is enabled.

nrpe_ssl_ca_cert_file.description: Path to optional CA certificate for validating client certificates (if client cert auth is used). Empty disables CA validation.

nrpe_ssl_check_peer.description: Whether to verify the client's SSL certificate (if client certs are used).

nrpe_ssl_check_host.description: Whether to verify the hostname in the client's certificate matches the connecting host.

items.description: Directory path containing additional command definition files (*.cfg).

include_cmd_def_paths.description: List of directories from which to load extra command definitions. Standard path: /etc/nagios/nrpe.d

name.description: Unique command name used in Nagios service definitions (e.g., 'check_load')

executable.description: Full path to the plugin/check script (e.g., '/usr/lib/nagios/plugins/check_disk')

items.description: Command-line arguments passed to the executable (space-separated in final config).

custom_commands.description: List of custom command definitions. Each defines a named check available to Nagios.
